title: [Đề 13 - Tổng Duyệt] Đề Thi Mẫu Tổng Duyệt Toàn Diện VNU Test Bậc 3 (Full Mock Test)
description: Bài thi mẫu tổng duyệt toàn diện 4 kỹ năng chuẩn đầu ra Tiếng Anh Bậc 3 (CEFR B1): Opportunities in the Finance Industry (Part 2), Generation Z Facing Problems in the Workplace (Part 3), My Job at Vietnam News (Part 4), Organizing a Party & Acid Rain (Writing), Golden Garden Restaurant & PowerBoost Advertisement (Speaking).

tasks.title: Part 1: Signs & Notices
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. Look at the text in each question. What does it say? Choose the correct letter A, B, or C.

questions.prompt:
UNIVERSITY LIBRARY
Please wait here while staff check your books.

options.text: Do not go away until we have checked your books.
Check you have all your books before leaving the library.
Do not leave books here for staff to check.

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo tại thư viện đại học: 'Please wait here while staff check your books' (Vui lòng đợi ở đây trong khi nhân viên kiểm tra sách của bạn). Điều này tương đương với 'Do not go away until we have checked your books' (Đừng rời đi cho đến khi chúng tôi kiểm tra xong sách của bạn). Đáp án chính thức của sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 1. A.

questions.prompt:
Need to relax after our journey – car broke down (fixed now!). At this hotel until 16th then staying overnight with Anna on the way home.
Kay

options.text: Kay broke her car on the way to the hotel, and she is trying to fix it.
Kay is staying at Anna's house until the 16th before going home.
Kay is relaxing at a hotel after her car trouble and will visit Anna later.

questions.explanationVi: Tin nhắn của Kay: cần nghỉ ngơi sau chuyến đi vì xe bị hỏng (nay đã sửa xong), ở khách sạn này đến ngày 16 rồi nghỉ qua đêm với Anna trên đường về. Phương án C tóm tắt chính xác nội dung. Đáp án chính thức của sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 2. C.

questions.prompt:
Hi Sam,
Thanks for taking me to the airport yesterday. I left my umbrella in your car! Can I get it back tonight?
Best,
Nick

options.text: Nick is thanking Sam for lending him an umbrella for his flight.
Nick wants Sam to pick him up from the airport tonight.
Nick left his umbrella in Sam's car and wants to collect it tonight.

questions.explanationVi: Email của Nick gửi Sam: cảm ơn đã chở ra sân bay hôm qua, để quên chiếc ô trong xe của Sam và hỏi tối nay có thể lấy lại được không ('collect it tonight'). Đáp án chính thức của sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 3. C.

questions.prompt:
CITY BUS SERVICE
Exact change only.
Drivers cannot give change.

options.text: Passengers must have the exact amount of money for the bus ticket.
Bus drivers can only accept bank cards for tickets.
Passengers can ask the driver for smaller coins.

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo trên xe buýt: 'Exact change only. Drivers cannot give change' (Chỉ nhận đúng số tiền lẻ vừa khít. Tài xế không thể trả lại tiền thừa). Do đó hành khách phải chuẩn bị đúng số tiền mua vé ('exact amount of money'). Đáp án chính thức của sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 4. A.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: tiền lẻ vừa đúng số tiền cần trả

questions.prompt:
NOTICE TO ALL STAFF
Please switch off all lights and computers before leaving the office.

options.text: Employees must turn off office equipment and lights when they go home.
Only the last person leaving the building needs to turn off the computers.
Lights will automatically turn off when computers are shut down.

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo cho nhân viên: 'Please switch off all lights and computers before leaving the office' (Vui lòng tắt toàn bộ đèn và máy tính trước khi rời văn phòng). 'switch off' đồng nghĩa với 'turn off'. Đáp án chính thức của sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 5. A.

questions.prompt:
SWIMMING POOL RULES
Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult at all times.

options.text: Children under 12 are not allowed to use the swimming pool.
An adult must stay with children younger than 12 in the pool area.
Adults can only swim when there are no children in the pool.

questions.explanationVi: Nội quy bể bơi: 'Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult at all times' (Trẻ em dưới 12 tuổi phải luôn có người lớn đi kèm). Phương án B ('An adult must stay with children younger than 12') diễn đạt chính xác quy định này. Đáp án chính thức của sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 6. B.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: được đi kèm bởi, có ai đi cùng

questions.prompt:
LUCY CAFÉ
20% discount for all university students!
Show your student card when ordering.

options.text: All customers at Lucy Café can get a 20% discount today.
University students pay less if they present their student ID card.
Students can order food online to receive a 20% discount.

questions.explanationVi: Biển quảng cáo tại quán cà phê Lucy: Giảm giá 20% cho tất cả sinh viên đại học khi xuất trình thẻ sinh viên lúc gọi đồ ('pay less if they present their student ID card'). Đáp án chính thức của sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 7. B.

tasks.title: Part 2: Gap-Fill Cloze
tasks.instructions: Read the text below about opportunities in the finance industry and choose the correct word (A, B, or C) for each space from 8 to 15.

passage.title: Opportunities in the Finance Industry
passage.text:
The finance industry is growing quickly and offers many great career opportunities. People who want to work in finance usually need to have a strong background (8) ________ mathematics, economics, or business. Many universities offer degree programs that prepare students for jobs in banking, investment, and insurance.

To succeed in this field, employees must be able to analyze financial data and (9) ________ good decisions under pressure. Nowadays, companies also look for candidates (10) ________ have strong communication and computer skills. Technology has changed the way banks work, and digital banking is becoming (11) ________ popular than ever before.

New graduates often start as junior analysts. During their first year, they receive practical training from experienced managers. This helps them understand how the market operates and how to manage risks (12) ________. Although working hours in finance can be long and tiring, the industry provides (13) ________ salaries and clear paths for promotion. If you enjoy working with numbers and solving problems, a career in finance can be very (14) ________. Many professionals say they never feel bored (15) ________ the financial world changes every single day.

questions.prompt: People who want to work in finance usually need to have a strong background (8) ________ mathematics, economics, or business.
questions.explanationVi: Cụm giới từ cố định: 'have a background in something' (có nền tảng chuyên môn về lĩnh vực gì). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 8. C.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: nền tảng kiến thức/kinh nghiệm về

questions.prompt: To succeed in this field, employees must be able to analyze financial data and (9) ________ good decisions under pressure.
questions.explanationVi: Collocation cố định: 'make decisions' (đưa ra quyết định). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 9. B.

questions.prompt: Nowadays, companies also look for candidates (10) ________ have strong communication and computer skills.
questions.explanationVi: Đại từ quan hệ 'who' thay thế cho danh từ chỉ người 'candidates' và làm chủ ngữ cho động từ 'have'. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 10. A.

questions.prompt: Technology has changed the way banks work, and digital banking is becoming (11) ________ popular than ever before.
questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc so sánh hơn với tính từ dài 'popular' và có từ 'than' phía sau: 'more popular than ever before'. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 11. B.

questions.prompt: This helps them understand how the market operates and how to manage risks (12) ________.
questions.explanationVi: Cần một trạng từ ('effectively') đứng sau bổ nghĩa cho cụm động từ 'manage risks' (quản lý rủi ro một cách hiệu quả). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 12. C.

questions.prompt: Although working hours in finance can be long and tiring, the industry provides (13) ________ salaries and clear paths for promotion.
questions.explanationVi: Kết hợp từ chuẩn với 'salaries' (mức lương): 'high salaries' (lương cao). Không dùng 'tall' hay 'wide' cho lương. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 13. A.

questions.prompt: If you enjoy working with numbers and solving problems, a career in finance can be very (14) ________.
questions.explanationVi: 'rewarding' (đáng giá, bổ ích, mang lại nhiều thành quả) phù hợp ngữ cảnh tích cực nói về sự nghiệp tài chính. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 14. C.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: bổ ích, đáng làm, mang lại thành quả

questions.prompt: Many professionals say they never feel bored (15) ________ the financial world changes every single day.
questions.explanationVi: Liên từ 'because' (bởi vì) nối mệnh đề chỉ nguyên nhân khiến các chuyên gia không bao giờ cảm thấy nhàm chán. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 15. B.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: chuyên gia, người làm nghề chuyên nghiệp

tasks.title: Part 3: True / False
tasks.instructions: Read the text about Generation Z in the workplace and decide if each statement (16–20) is True (A) or False (B).

passage.title: Generation Z Facing Problems in the Workplace
passage.text:
As Generation Z — people born between 1997 and 2012 — enters the workforce, many companies are noticing new challenges. A recent survey of 1,300 managers by ResumeBuilder found that three in four managers believe Gen Z employees are harder to work with than older generations.

One major reason is the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. Many Gen Z graduates had to study online during their university years and missed out on face-to-face communication. As a result, some young workers find it difficult to make eye contact, participate in office meetings, or handle direct feedback from their bosses. In addition, having grown up with smartphones and social media, they are used to quick text messages rather than formal emails or phone calls.

However, career experts say that companies should not blame young workers. Instead, employers ought to provide clear onboarding programs and soft-skills training to help Gen Z adapt to office culture. In fact, Gen Z employees bring valuable strengths to the workplace: they learn new technologies quickly, care deeply about mental health and work-life balance, and often suggest creative ways to work more efficiently.

questions.prompt: According to the survey, most managers find it more difficult to work with Gen Z than with other generations.
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 1 nêu rõ: 'three in four managers (75% = hầu hết các quản lý) believe Gen Z employees are harder to work with than older generations'. Nhận định hoàn toàn khớp với bài đọc. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 16. T (A).

questions.prompt: Online learning during the pandemic helped Gen Z improve their face-to-face communication skills.
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 2 viết: 'Many Gen Z graduates had to study online during their university years and missed out on face-to-face communication' (bỏ lỡ mất cơ hội giao tiếp trực tiếp, chứ không phải cải thiện). Nhận định là SAI. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 17. F (B).

vocabularyNotes.meaning: bỏ lỡ mất cơ hội trải nghiệm điều gì

questions.prompt: Many young employees are more familiar with texting than writing formal office emails.
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 2 viết: 'they are used to quick text messages rather than formal emails or phone calls' (quen với tin nhắn nhanh hơn là email trang trọng). Nhận định là ĐÚNG. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 18. T (A).

questions.prompt: Career experts advise companies to stop hiring Gen Z graduates until they learn soft skills at university.
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 3 viết: 'employers ought to provide clear onboarding programs and soft-skills training to help Gen Z adapt to office culture' (doanh nghiệp nên tổ chức đào tạo hội nhập và kỹ năng mềm, chứ không phải ngừng tuyển dụng). Nhận định là SAI. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 19. F (B).

questions.prompt: Gen Z workers are quick at learning new technology and value a healthy balance between work and life.
questions.explanationVi: Câu cuối bài đọc nêu rõ: 'they learn new technologies quickly, care deeply about mental health and work-life balance'. Nhận định là ĐÚNG. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 20. T (A).

vocabularyNotes.meaning: sự cân bằng giữa công việc và cuộc sống

tasks.title: Part 4: Reading Comprehension
tasks.instructions: Read the passage 'My Job at Vietnam News' and choose the correct answer (A, B, or C) for each question from 21 to 25.

passage.title: My Job at Vietnam News
passage.text:
I work as an editor at Viet Nam News, the main English-language newspaper in Vietnam, which has been published by the Vietnam News Agency since 1991. Every day, our team works hard to bring reliable news about Vietnam's politics, economy, culture, and social life to both foreign readers and Vietnamese people who are learning English.

My daily routine starts at 8:00 a.m. In the morning, I attend an editorial meeting where we choose the most important stories of the day. After that, I spend several hours checking articles written by young reporters and translating news reports from Vietnamese into English. Making sure that every article is accurate, natural, and easy to understand is the most challenging part of my job, especially when we have tight deadlines late in the afternoon.

What I love most about working at Viet Nam News is the opportunity to learn something new every day. One day I might edit a report on green energy projects in the Mekong Delta, and the next day I could be reading about traditional craft villages near Hanoi. Although digital media has created strong competition for print newspapers, our online edition now reaches thousands of readers around the world.

questions.prompt: What is true about Viet Nam News according to paragraph 1?

options.text: It is written only for foreign tourists visiting Vietnam.
It is a weekly magazine about Vietnamese history.
It is a major English-language newspaper started in 1991.

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 1 nêu rõ: 'Viet Nam News, the main English-language newspaper in Vietnam, which has been published by the Vietnam News Agency since 1991'. Phương án C chính xác. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 21. C.

questions.prompt: What does the writer do after the morning editorial meeting?

options.text: He checks reporters' articles and translates news into English.
He travels to the Mekong Delta to interview local farmers.
He designs the website layout for the online edition.

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 2 viết: 'After that, I spend several hours checking articles written by young reporters and translating news reports from Vietnamese into English'. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 22. A.

questions.prompt: The word 'tight' in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ________.

options.text: strict and with very little time

questions.explanationVi: Trong cụm 'tight deadlines' (hạn chót gấp rút/sát nút), từ 'tight' mang nghĩa nghiêm ngặt và có rất ít thời gian ('strict and with very little time'). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 23. A.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: hạn chót gấp rút, sát nút

questions.prompt: Why does the writer enjoy working at Viet Nam News?

options.text: Because the job has no pressure or deadlines.
Because it allows him to learn new things about different topics every day.
Because he gets to travel abroad every week.

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 3 nêu rõ: 'What I love most about working at Viet Nam News is the opportunity to learn something new every day'. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 24. B.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the passage?

options.text: To explain the history of print newspapers in Asia
To advertise a job opening for young translators
To describe the daily work and experiences of an editor at Viet Nam News

questions.explanationVi: Toàn bài viết mô tả công việc biên tập hàng ngày, những thử thách và niềm vui nghề nghiệp của tác giả tại tờ báo Viet Nam News. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 25. C.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: ấn bản điện tử / báo mạng

tasks.title: Part 1: Short Announcements & Monologues
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. You will hear seven short recordings TWICE. For each question (1–7), choose the correct answer A, B, or C.
tasks.transcript:
[Question 1]: Thank you for calling the Royal Concert Hall. Tonight's classical music concert will begin at 7:30 p.m. Tickets are available at the box office. Regular tickets cost 15 pounds, and student tickets are 10 pounds. However, if you come with a group of ten or more people, you only pay 12 pounds per ticket.

[Question 2]: Good morning, class. Before we start today's history lesson, I have a quick reminder about your homework. Please read Chapter 4 and write a short report about life in ancient cities. You don't need to finish it by tomorrow, as we have a school trip on Thursday. Please hand it in on Friday morning.

[Question 3]: Welcome to our store! Today we have a special summer sale on the second floor. All men's jackets are 20% off, and sports shoes are 30% off. Best of all, if you are looking for women's dresses, they are half price today only!

[Question 4]: Attention passengers waiting for the train to Manchester. Due to heavy rain along the track, the 10:15 train has been delayed by 30 minutes and will now depart at 10:45 from Platform 3. We apologize for the inconvenience.

[Question 5]: Hi Sarah, it's Mark. I'm calling from the café near the cinema. You left your blue notebook on the table when you went to catch your bus! I have it with me now, so I'll bring it to your office tomorrow morning.

[Question 6]: Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to the National Science Museum! We will start our tour in the Space Hall on the ground floor, then visit the Dinosaur Exhibition on the first floor. At 3:00 p.m., we will watch a short 3D film about the ocean before finishing at the gift shop.

[Question 7]: And now for the weekend weather forecast. While Friday will remain cloudy with light rain in the morning, Saturday will be bright, warm, and sunny all day—perfect for outdoor activities! On Sunday, strong winds will return in the evening.

questions.prompt: How much does a concert ticket cost for a student?
questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn băng ghi âm (Câu 1): 'Regular tickets cost 15 pounds, and student tickets are 10 pounds'. Vé dành cho sinh viên có giá 10 bảng Anh. Đáp án chính thức: 1. B.

questions.prompt: When must the students hand in their history report?
questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn băng ghi âm (Câu 2): 'You don't need to finish it by tomorrow, as we have a school trip on Thursday. Please hand it in on Friday morning'. Học sinh nộp bài vào sáng thứ Sáu. Đáp án chính thức: 2. A.

questions.prompt: Which item has a 50% discount in the store today?
questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn băng ghi âm (Câu 3): 'if you are looking for women's dresses, they are half price today only!' ('half price' = giảm giá 50%). Đáp án chính thức: 3. C.

questions.prompt: What time will the train to Manchester leave now?
questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn băng ghi âm (Câu 4): 'the 10:15 train has been delayed by 30 minutes and will now depart at 10:45 from Platform 3'. Đáp án chính thức: 4. B.

questions.prompt: What did Sarah leave at the café?
questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn băng ghi âm (Câu 5): 'You left your blue notebook on the table when you went to catch your bus!'. Đáp án chính thức: 5. C.

questions.prompt: Where will the museum visitors go first?
questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn băng ghi âm (Câu 6): 'We will start our tour in the Space Hall on the ground floor, then visit the Dinosaur Exhibition...'. Đáp án chính thức: 6. B.

questions.prompt: What will the weather be like on Saturday?
questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn băng ghi âm (Câu 7): 'Saturday will be bright, warm, and sunny all day—perfect for outdoor activities!'. Đáp án chính thức: 7. A.

tasks.title: Part 2: Short Conversations
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. You will hear seven short conversations TWICE. For each question (8–14), choose the correct answer A, B, or C.
tasks.transcript:
[Question 8]:
Woman: Excuse me, is this table near the window free?
Man: I'm sorry, a family of four has just reserved the window table. We have a quiet table in the corner or one outside in the garden.
Woman: It's a bit windy outside today, so I'll take the one in the corner, please.

[Question 9]:
Man: Hi Anna, are you taking the bus to the company conference tomorrow morning?
Woman: Actually, the bus takes too long in morning traffic, and my bike has a flat tire. So I'm taking the underground train instead.
Man: Good idea! I'll meet you at the station.

[Question 10]:
Woman: Happy birthday, David! Did your parents get you the new watch you wanted?
Man: My sister bought me a nice watch, and my best friend gave me a bestselling novel. My parents knew I needed something for my university classes, so they gave me a new laptop!

[Question 11]:
Man: You look tired, Emma. Did you stay up late watching a movie?
Woman: No, I went to bed early, but my neighbor's dog was barking loudly all night, so I could hardly sleep.
Man: Oh no, you should get some rest this afternoon.

[Question 12]:
Woman: Do you want to play tennis this Saturday morning, Tom?
Man: I'd love to, but I have a dentist appointment at 9:30, and then I'm having lunch with my grandparents. How about Saturday afternoon at 4:00?
Woman: 4:00 p.m. works great for me!

[Question 13]:
Man: How is your new apartment, Lisa? Is it closer to the office?
Woman: Yes, it's only a ten-minute walk to work, and the rent is quite reasonable! The only problem is that the kitchen is really small, so there's barely enough space to cook.

[Question 14]:
Woman: Excuse me, I'd like to send this parcel to London. How much is express delivery?
Man: Express delivery arrives tomorrow morning and costs 14 pounds. Standard delivery takes three days and costs 8 pounds.
Woman: It's not urgent, so standard delivery is fine, thank you.

questions.prompt: Where does the woman decide to sit in the restaurant?
questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn băng ghi âm (Câu 8): Người phụ nữ nói 'It's a bit windy outside today, so I'll take the one in the corner, please'. Đáp án chính thức: 8. C.

questions.prompt: How will Anna travel to the conference tomorrow?
questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn băng ghi âm (Câu 9): Anna nói 'So I'm taking the underground train instead'. Đáp án chính thức: 9. A.

questions.prompt: What birthday present did David receive from his parents?
questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn băng ghi âm (Câu 10): 'My parents knew I needed something for my university classes, so they gave me a new laptop!'. Đáp án chính thức: 10. B.

questions.prompt: Why couldn't Emma sleep well last night?

options.text: She stayed up late watching a movie.
She drank too much coffee in the evening.
Her neighbor's dog was making noise.

questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn băng ghi âm (Câu 11): 'my neighbor's dog was barking loudly all night, so I could hardly sleep'. Đáp án chính thức: 11. C.

questions.prompt: When will Tom and the woman play tennis?
questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn băng ghi âm (Câu 12): Tom đề nghị 'How about Saturday afternoon at 4:00?' và người phụ nữ đồng ý. Đáp án chính thức: 12. B.

questions.prompt: What does Lisa dislike about her new apartment?

options.text: It is far from her office.

questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn băng ghi âm (Câu 13): 'The only problem is that the kitchen is really small, so there's barely enough space to cook'. Đáp án chính thức: 13. A.

questions.prompt: How much will the woman pay to send her parcel?
questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn băng ghi âm (Câu 14): Chuyển phát tiêu chuẩn ('standard delivery') có giá 8 bảng Anh và người phụ nữ chọn gói này ('standard delivery is fine'). Đáp án chính thức: 14. B.

tasks.title: Part 3: Extended Talks (Correct / Incorrect)
tasks.instructions: There are 6 questions in this part. You will hear two longer recordings TWICE. Decide whether each statement from 15 to 20 is Correct (A) or Incorrect (B).
tasks.transcript:
[Recording 1 - Questions 15 to 17]:
In this part, you will hear two recordings. You will hear each recording twice. Look at questions 15 to 17.
Speaker: Many people find it difficult to fall asleep at night. However, making a few simple changes to your daily routine can help you sleep much better. First, you should go to bed and wake up at the same time every day, even on weekends. This helps your body keep a natural clock. Second, avoid drinking coffee or tea in the late afternoon or evening. Instead, a cup of warm milk or herbal tea before bed can help you relax. Finally, make sure your bedroom is dark, quiet, and cool, and turn off your phone or computer at least 30 minutes before sleeping.

[Recording 2 - Questions 18 to 20]:
Now look at questions 18 to 20.
Speaker: Exam season can be a stressful time for students, so taking care of your body and mind is very important. First, eat food that gives you energy. tasks.title: Task 1: How to Prepare for a Job Interview
tasks.instructions: Write a paragraph of at least 80 words about how to prepare for a job interview. Use the suggested steps in the box below.

writingPrompts.title: How to Prepare for a Job Interview
writingPrompts.instructions: Write a paragraph of at least 80 words describing the steps to prepare for a job interview.

dataCard.Step 1 (Before the interview): Research the company and the job position carefully
dataCard.Step 2 (Practice): Prepare answers for common interview questions
dataCard.Step 3 (Appearance): Choose neat, formal clothes to make a good first impression
dataCard.Step 4 (On the interview day): Arrive 10-15 minutes early, stay calm and confident

writingPrompts.sampleAnswer: Preparing carefully for a job interview is very important if you want to get your dream job. First of all, you should research the company and read the job description carefully to understand what they are looking for. Second, it is a good idea to practice answering common interview questions at home so that you can speak clearly and confidently. Third, you need to prepare neat and formal clothes the night before to make a great first impression on the interviewers. Finally, on the day of the interview, remember to bring copies of your CV and arrive at least 15 minutes early. Following these simple steps will help you feel relaxed and succeed in your interview.

tasks.title: Task 2: Paragraph Writing
tasks.instructions: Choose ONE of the two topics below and write a paragraph of at least 100 words.

writingPrompts.instructions: Choose ONE topic and write a paragraph of at least 100 words.

topicChoices.topic: Write a paragraph of at least 100 words about ways to limit plastic waste in daily life.
guidelines: Bring reusable cloth bags when going shopping
Use personal water bottles instead of buying single-use plastic bottles
Refuse plastic straws and classify household waste for recycling

topicChoices.topic: Write a paragraph of at least 100 words about the benefits of developing tourism in your country.
guidelines: Creates jobs and improves income for local people
Brings foreign currency and boosts the national economy
Promotes local culture, food, and historical sites to international friends

writingPrompts.sampleAnswer: There are several practical ways that individuals can do every day to limit plastic waste and protect our environment. Firstly, we should form the habit of bringing our own reusable cloth bags whenever we go to the supermarket or local market instead of taking free plastic bags. Secondly, carrying a personal reusable water bottle or thermos to school and work is an effective way to reduce millions of single-use plastic bottles thrown away each day. Finally, consumers ought to say no to disposable plastic straws and containers when ordering takeaway food and drinks. By making these small changes in our daily habits, we can significantly reduce plastic pollution and keep our planet green.

tasks.title: Part 2: Topic Description & Discussion
tasks.instructions: Choose ONE of the two cue cards below. Prepare for 1 minute and speak for 1.5–2 minutes, then answer two follow-up questions.

cueCards.title: Describe a restaurant that you enjoyed going to (e.g., Golden Garden).
prompts: Who you went there with and what food you ordered
Why you enjoyed eating at that restaurant
furtherQuestions: What makes a restaurant popular with young people nowadays?
Do you think fast food restaurants are good or bad for people's health?
cueCards.sampleResponse: I would like to talk about Golden Garden, a wonderful Vietnamese restaurant located near West Lake in Hanoi. Last month, I went there with my family to celebrate my mother's birthday. We ordered grilled fish, fresh spring rolls, and lotus seed soup. I really enjoyed this restaurant because the food was delicious and healthy, the space was quiet with lots of green trees, and the waiters were very friendly.

cueCards.title: Describe an interesting advertisement you have seen recently (e.g., PowerBoost).
prompts: Where and when you saw the advertisement
What product it was advertising and what happened in it
Why you found this advertisement memorable
furtherQuestions: How do advertisements influence what people buy?
Should advertisements aimed at young children be controlled strictly?
cueCards.sampleResponse: I'd like to describe an interesting advertisement for an energy drink called PowerBoost that I saw on YouTube last week. The video showed a tired office worker who drank PowerBoost and suddenly had the energy to finish all his reports and run a marathon after work. I found it memorable because the music was very catchy and the story was funny.
